title: [Devlog] Transit, Squads, Hacking, Cargo, Physics & Planets in my Three.js Multiplayer Game (Sidera Caeli)
author: danidomen
selftext:
Here is a new quick recap of some of the systems I've been implementing in **Sidera Caeli**, my browser-based multiplayer space game.

This time I'm showing station transit, squad invitations and tracking, door hacking, synchronised multiplayer flight, physical cargo handling, and a little preview of planetary environments.

And yes, **AI is heavily involved**. All the code is being built from scratch with AI assistance, based on my own architecture, specifications, designs and documentation. I'm mainly handling systems design, implementation direction, testing and QA.

It's still very much a **testbed**, not a finished game. Plenty of placeholders, debug overlays and things thrown together just to see how everything behaves and connects.

There's also a public browser testbed available if anyone wants to try things out, including multiplayer.

Still a long way to go, but I'm having a lot of fun seeing all these systems come together. Feedback is always welcome! :)
